author: Rebeca Rodriguez

events.description: Mission Support reported that the trailer water tank had ruptured.
events.source_quote: At 12:35pm we received a message from Mission Support stating the trailer tank had ruptured.

events.description: Hot water has not been attained despite mitigation attempts and power cycling the water heater.
events.source_quote: The hot water has still not been attained.

events.description: ATV 3 powered on but shut down after 20 seconds, and the droplet light failed to turn on.
events.source_quote:
ATV 3 powered on, 
but after 20 seconds shut down. The droplet light on ATV 3 did not turn on as it had done before.

questions_to_mission_support:
The report states for us to record Initial Potable Water Meter Reading (Gallons: xxxxx.xy). Which water tank is this referring to? Please 
advise.
Please advise on additional procedures we can try.
Please advise on proper use and capacity.

We request 
to change this setup and cover with an extra mattress, as it is difficult with gloves to properly secure the ties after removing them.
